title: American Heart Association testifies against soft-drink removal in the Texas Senate

tellings.quote: And the American Heart Association, this is the world we live in now, the American Heart Association showed up to testify against us at the original one.

plain: When an effort to remove soft drinks came before the Texas Senate in Austin sometime in the 2020s, the American Heart Association showed up to testify against it, according to Brigham Buhler, who was part of that effort. Buhler tells Michels this from having been there, calling it a sign of "the world we live in now," since a heart health group took the side of the soda.
